name: Yimi Wang
headline: Senior Azure Solution Engineer @ Microsoft Innovation Hub Zürich
summary:
Grüezi! I'm Yimi, a German-Chinese tech professional, passionate about AI, application development, cloud computing, and business innovation – basically, I speak fluent tech and love translating it into real-world solutions. 

Let's connect!

positions.title: Senior Azure Solution Engineer - Microsoft Innovation Hub & Office of the CTO
positions.description:
• Lead Azure architecture engagements that turn complex business problems into practical, implementable solutions. I facilitate executive design sessions, develop proof of concepts, and provide technical direction across automation, data strategy, integration, and cloud architecture.

• Expertise in enterprise architecture, consultative selling, AI solution design, and design thinking, with a focus on delivering impactful customer engagements.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Natural Language Processing (NLP): Readability modeling, age-of-acquisition features, text complexity prediction, and grade-aware text generation.

• Large Language Models (LLMs): Fine-tuning (e.g., Mistral 7B with Unsloth), evaluation across fidelity/readability dimensions, and agentic LLM design patterns.

• Machine Learning & Hybrid Models: Combining Random Forest, Ridge regression, and synthetic data for extrapolation beyond training ranges.

• Similarity & Evaluation Metrics: Semantic embeddings (SBERT), entailment models (NLI), ROUGE-based measures for stricter fidelity checks.

• Software Engineering: Flask/Python backends, React/TypeScript frontends, SQLAlchemy ORM, and MLOps pipelines for scalable deployments.

positions.title: Solution Engineer - Azure AI App
positions.description:
• Enable Swiss enterprise AI developers to integrate AI agents and orchestrators into their workflows to unlock productivity through Agentic AI design patterns via hands-on technical engagements (PoCs, hackathons, MVPs, workshops).

• Designe secure, scalable AI application architectures integrating containerization (Kubernetes), microservices, and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps (version control, model registry, deployment pipelines, monitoring, etc.)

• Collaborate closely with engineering teams to resolve technical blockers and feed customer insights into Microsoft’s product development.

• Technical Focus Areas:
Full-stack AI applications: TensorFlow, PyTorch, LLM fine-tuning, inference pipelines, Responsible AI
Cloud-native development: Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions, GitHub Actions, and microservices
Agentic AI frameworks, GenAI Ops, AI orchestration, security (e.g., Sentinel), and monitoring
Developer tools: VS Code, GitHub Copilot Studio, Python, Node.js, Jupyter

positions.title: Technology Consultant - AI & ML
positions.description:
• Led a developer team, designed the architecture, and developed backend services for a GenAI chatbot with RAG. It integrates SAP's internal confidential data with comprehensive internet public data. Targeted users are over 20k. First go-live in North America.

• Provided strategic and architectural technical guidance on GenAI & ML adoption, helping clients maximize value through the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and integrating GenAI models into existing workflows.

• Acted as a technical coach in SAP Business AI hackathons, guiding participants in AI, cloud, and machine learning projects.

• Used technology: 
 - Programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java
 - AI Toolings: SAP Generative AI Hub, PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain, Azure AI Studio
 - Frontend: SAP UI5, CSS, HTML, XML
 - Backend: SAP HANA DB, SAP AI Core, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud

company.description:
Every company has a mission. What's ours? To empower every person and every organization to achieve more. We believe technology can and should be a force for good and that meaningful innovation contributes to a brighter world in the future and today. Our culture doesn’t just encourage curiosity; it embraces it. Each day we make progress together by showing up as our authentic selves. We show up with a learn-it-all mentality. We show up cheering on others, knowing their success doesn't diminish our own. We show up every day open to learning our own biases, changing our behavior, and inviting in differences. Because impact matters. 

Microsoft operates in 190 countries and is made up of approximately 228,000 passionate employees worldwide.
